comparison.objective: Screen media from washers, versus standing a box on edge in a slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular flow and bimanual load sharing versus reorienting a box and inserting it into a constrained slot.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media mass and retained washers versus box stably seated on edge in the target slot.
comparison.reason: Constrained rigid-body placement does not test selective passage or bridge clearing.
